verdict.rationale: Kling's agent lets users brainstorm, write scripts and generate media, which is creative ideation rather than AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data. Nothing in the pack documents analysis of user data, usage, or performance to produce insights. That makes the agent brainstorming adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Brainstorm with your Agent, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards
